task.title: Escape digest drops the ISO-53 week and 500s on an unparseable detected_at
task.body:
Filed from the sampled-audit adjudication on PR #9820 (upheld). Two defects in `escape.digest.build_digest`, both reachable from the live `GET /api/insights/escape-digest` route.

## 1. ISO-week keys are sorted as strings

`build_digest` buckets records with `f"{year}-W{week:02d}"` from `datetime.isocalendar()`, then takes the newest N with `sorted(grouped, reverse=True)[:weeks]`. ISO week-numbering years are not calendar years, so the string order and the chronological order disagree at a year boundary.

Concretely: `2027-01-02T10:00:00+00:00` is ISO `2026-W53` (2026 is a 53-week ISO year), and `2027-01-05T10:00:00+00:00` is `2027-W01`. Expected newest-first order is `["2027-W01", "2026-W53"]`. Observed on staging@7c1f9ad: `2026-W53` is ranked below `2026-W30` and falls outside the default 8-week window, so an escape recorded in the last week of December disappears from the digest.

## 2. One malformed timestamp 500s the whole digest

`datetime.fromisoformat(rec.detected_at)` is called unguarded. Issue #9812's acceptance list required an unparseable `detected_at` to land in an `unknown` bucket and be logged once per digest build. Instead the ValueError propagates out of the route handler.

Reproduced by hand against a copy of the 2026-07 ledger:

```
$ jq -r '.detected_at' escape_ledger.jsonl | sed -n '17p'
2026-07-1O T09:14:00+00:00     # capital O, hand-edited row from the #10498 migration
$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:8000/api/insights/escape-digest?weeks=8
500
```

Server log:

```
ERROR  uvicorn.error:h11_impl.py:407 Exception in ASGI application
  File "/app/src/escape/digest.py", line 33, in build_digest
    stamp = datetime.fromisoformat(rec.detected_at)
ValueError: Invalid isoformat string: '2026-07-1O T09:14:00+00:00'
```

## Expected

- Newest-first ordering by real week start date, so `2026-W53` outranks `2026-W30`.
- An unparseable `detected_at` is counted in an `unknown` bucket, logged once per digest build, and never fails the request.

## Affected

- `src/escape/digest.py` (`build_digest`)
- `src/server_routes_insights.py` (`escape_digest` route, 500 surface)
- Existing coverage in `tests/test_escape_digest.py` spans 2026-W28 and 2026-W30 only, so neither defect is exercised today.
comments: Adjudicator upheld the auditor on both counts; the by_stratum gap is tracked separately as #9862.
Confirmed the 500 is reachable from the dashboard Insights tab, not just curl.
